nodes.text:
The first case of HMPV virus has been detected in Bengaluru. However, experts assure there's no need to panic as this virus has been present for decades. Stay safe, and continue following the health ministry's guidelines as they update them from time to time. 

#StaySafe https://t.co/z9LTJBwJkQ
